mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_user ( email, nickname, role, is_approved, can_create_blog, can_create_board, board_create_quota, image_upload_limit_count, image_size_limit_bytes, management_blocked, profile_restricted, phone_number, profile_image_url, profile_blog_title, profile_etc, use_kakao_auth, kakao_id ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{nickname}, #{role}, #{approved}, #{canCreateBlog}, #{canCreateBoard}, #{boardCreateQuota}, #{imageUploadLimitCount}, #{imageSizeLimitBytes}, #{managementBlocked}, #{profileRestricted}, #{phoneNumber}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{profileBlogTitle}, #{profileEtc}, #{useKakaoAuth}, #{kakaoId} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_user ORDER BY user_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_user SET is_approved = #{approved}, can_create_blog = #{canCreateBlog}, can_create_board = #{canCreateBoard}, board_create_quota = #{boardCreateQuota}, image_upload_limit_count = #{imageUploadLimitCount}, image_size_limit_bytes = #{imageSizeLimitBytes} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
